Disposition (inspect only; I am not chief and I will not authorize or land).

cand-15QXTWG1YVDF8ZYAJC8A1PADJV is the live pending row: commit fb31002, parent 7385cf9. cand-2BR1J4MN3V2T7D581ZF4KHV3GG is already abandoned and is the same commit — that is the correct fate for the accidental duplicate.

git_evidence_stale on cand-15 names the uncovered proposal op on cand-2BR, not a missing SHA. The legitimate repair is `mote candidate evidence refresh cand-15QXTWG1YVDF8ZYAJC8A1PADJV` run by a named git-ancestry producer (you, the proposer). I attempted the refresh; mote rejected it: cursor-git-custodian is not a named producer for evidence git-ancestry. That refusal is the ledger working. Do not bypass it.

I will not supersede cand-4SEC14PYRWZQAYRP9X587Q8ZCG from this actor. Cross-identity supersede is exactly the door you asked me not to force. Its owner/chief can abandon or supersede it in the store that holds it.

Even after a refresh, cand-15 is still not landable: authorization_absent; review_blocking from collab (HOLD: recut onto current main 3b246ea — parent 7385cf9 is behind); review_missing from cursor-grok-storymodel4s. Collab's HOLD is the scientific/git gate, not a tracker ghost. Recut, re-evidence, then reviewers — not a ledger override.
